# Lab 2.7: Table Snapshots & Table Clones

## What We Are Going to Do
Take a read-only snapshot of a table, restore from it, create a writable clone, and compare how each is billed.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Create a snapshot.** Open `lab02.trips`, click **Snapshot**. Name it `trips_snap_v1` and set an expiration of 7 days. Click **Save**.

2. **[SQL] Create a snapshot and a clone with SQL.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE SNAPSHOT TABLE lab02.trips_snap_v2
CLONE lab02.trips
OPTIONS (expiration_timestamp = TIMESTAMP_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY));

CREATE TABLE lab02.trips_clone
CLONE lab02.trips;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Change the clone and the original.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">DELETE FROM lab02.trips_clone WHERE duration_minutes &lt; 5;
UPDATE lab02.trips SET subscriber_type = 'TEST' WHERE trip_id = (SELECT MIN(trip_id) FROM lab02.trips);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The snapshot is read-only. Try `DELETE FROM lab02.trips_snap_v2 WHERE TRUE;` and it fails.

4. **[CLI] Restore from a snapshot.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq cp --restore --no_clobber lab02.trips_snap_v1 lab02.trips_restored
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false \
'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab02.trips_restored WHERE subscriber_type = "TEST"'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The count is `0`, because the restore has the data from before the update.

5. **[SQL] Compare storage.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT table_name, total_logical_bytes, active_logical_bytes
FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_STORAGE
WHERE table_schema = 'lab02' AND table_name LIKE 'trips%';</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Snapshots and clones are billed only for data that differs from the base table.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Snapshot | Read-only, point in time, can expire |
| Clone | Writable copy |
| Restore | `bq cp --restore` creates a normal table |
| Storage cost | Only for changed data |
